title: Visual Quality Grading in AgriTech / Manufacturing:
prompt: **Visual Quality Grading in AgriTech / Manufacturing:** You need to grade fruit or industrial parts on a conveyor belt for size, weight, and surface defects using dual cameras. How do you handle specular glare, occlusions, stereo depth calibration, and real-time edge inference?
